predecessors.name: North Sea Empire
predecessors.text: Cliopatria's last North Sea Empire shape (1034-1039), of which only Denmark and England re-form in 1040

predecessors.name: Kingdom of England
predecessors.text: England under Harold Harefoot, who died on 17 March 1040 (H1)

successors.name: Kingdom of England
successors.text: England under Edward the Confessor (H1: Harthacnut 'was succeeded by Magnus in Denmark and Edward the Confessor in England')

ledger.x: 17 June 1040: Harthacnut lands at Sandwich and rules England and Denmark together.
8 June 1042: England leaves the union at Harthacnut's death.
8 June 1042: Harthacnut dies and Denmark passes to Magnus of Norway.

certainty.note: A union of two crowns across the North Sea; each kingdom's old frontiers, none fixed by treaty on the pages opened.
